title.narrative: Deepening Stakeholders' Engagement in Monitoring and Enhancing Accountability in Public Administration

description.narrative: The programme is designed to ¿strengthen JAMP¿s capacities and that of other CSOs to engage in policy dialogue at the national level¿ on matters relating to public financial management and accountability. The project will continue to ¿reinforce the voice and action of CSOs as monitors, advocates and partners in national and local policy dialogue.¿ It is also designed to ¿reinforce JAMP as a provider of information and expertise to foster transparency, public knowledge and participation¿.
